source_policy: Curated provider-neutral rules only; private source notes are not distributed.

rules: Keep the core conflict, character motivation, causal order, dialogue intent and ending constraint visible across adaptation.
Use opening hooks, turning points, emotional peaks and ending hooks as rhythm landmarks, not fixed timing formulas.
Externalize emotion enough to remain legible on a small vertical screen.
Every generated shot must map to a valid storyboard shot and preserve its visible characters, key action, location state and required prop facts.
Split incompatible simultaneous actions into executable shots and preserve declared temporal and spatial relations.
Continuity and editability take priority over spectacle.
Approve a style board, character identities, character turnarounds, required expression or pose sheets, location masters and key props before batch shot generation.
Locked assets are immutable. Revisions create a new version with a change note.
Paid foundation work and every scene group require a current human approval bound to the current state fingerprint.
Character identity anchors include face, hair, body proportions, costume, accessories and distinctive marks.
A turnaround shows consistent front, side and back views.
Only characters declared visible by the storyboard may be required in-frame; off-screen mentions do not imply visibility.
A location master defines spatial layout, materials, identifying objects and foreground, midground and background layers.
Create only the time-of-day or lighting variants required by the storyboard.
Shot composition must not contradict locked entrances, exits, relative positions or light direction without an explicit story reason.
Compile prompts from subject, action, environment, light and color, camera and framing, style and material quality.
Place unambiguous required elements early and carry the same concise style and identity anchors throughout the project.
Use general negative constraints plus targeted constraints derived from current evidence.
Blocking visual findings cite a real locked asset or storyboard JSON path and the inspected image.
Missing or corrupt files, stale approvals and identifier mismatches cannot be overridden.
Semantic visual findings may be human-overridden only with a recorded reason; subjective camera, color and style preferences remain advisory.
Describe camera motion with start and end states and preserve shot continuity into video generation.
Keep dialogue, ambience, effects and music in separate concerns; music should not mask speech.
Transitions, pacing and delivery exports are reviewed only after upstream assets are locked.
Never overwrite an accepted version; filenames and manifests carry stable IDs, versions and fingerprints.
Keep prior candidates, review evidence, approval history and change notes.
Do not store credentials in state, traces, tests or deliverables.

excluded_topics: platform promotion and vendor marketing claims
fixed color symbolism presented as universal truth
provider-specific defaults presented as universal rules
